verification.draftedBy: Claude, by reading the ingested NOFO text before the extractor was written or run
verification.note: Every quote is machine-checked to appear on its stated page (npm run nofo:eval validates this). The selection, categories and mandatory/conditional flags are NOT human-verified: a person must read the NOFO and confirm or correct each item before this set is treated as a manually verified reference. mandatory=null means the NOFO wording is 'should'/guidance or otherwise ambiguous.

items.title: Eligible applicant types

sources.quote: Eligible BUILD grant applicants are: States and the District of Columbia

items.title: Ineligible applicant types (federal agencies, non-profits, private entities, individuals)

sources.quote: The following are not eligible BUILD grant applicants: Federal agencies Non-profits Private entities Individuals

items.title: Minimum request for capital projects in urban areas ($5 million)

sources.quote: Applicants submitting capital grant applications for projects located in urban areas must request at least $5 million in BUILD funding

items.title: Minimum request for capital projects in rural areas ($1 million)

sources.quote: projects located in rural areas must request at least $1 million in BUILD funding

items.title: Each applicant may submit up to three applications

sources.quote: Each applicant can submit up to three applications.

items.title: Federal share may not exceed 80 percent unless rural or APP/HDC

sources.quote: The Federal share for BUILD grant projects shall not exceed 80 percent unless the project receives one of the following location designations

items.title: Urban projects (not APP/HDC) with more than 80 percent federal funding are ineligible

sources.quote: Projects located in an urban area, that are not designated APP/HDC, that have more than 80 percent federal funding will be ineligible.

items.title: Recipient must complete the project with at least the stated non-Federal funding

sources.quote: the terms of the award will require the recipient to complete the project using at least the amount of non-Federal funding that was specified in the application

items.title: Toll credits count as a Federal source, not non-Federal match

sources.quote: Toll credits under 23 U.S.C. 120(i) are considered a Federal source under the BUILD program.

items.title: Pre-award costs are ineligible for reimbursement and cost share

sources.quote: any costs incurred prior to the Department's obligation of funds for a project

items.title: Maximum BUILD funding request is $25 million

sources.quote: The maximum request amount is $25 million.

items.title: Ineligible project types (for example school buses, standalone broadband)

sources.quote: Ineligible projects are: Purchasing school buses Deploying broadband as a standalone project

items.title: Research, demonstration or pilot projects are eligible only if they lead to permanent infrastructure

sources.quote: Research, demonstration, or pilot projects are only eligible if they lead to long-term, permanent surface transportation infrastructure with independent utility

items.title: Components funded individually must independently meet minimums and eligibility

sources.quote: Components may be funded individually if they meet the following criteria: Independently satisfy minimum award amounts and eligibility requirements.

items.title: Grant funds must be obligated by September 30, 2030

sources.quote: FY 2026 BUILD grant funds must be obligated by September 30, 2030.

items.title: Application files: single-spaced, 12-point font, 1-inch margins

sources.quote: Single-spaced, 12-point standard font with 1-inch margins.

items.title: Applications must be complete at submission

sources.quote: Applications must be complete at submission

items.title: Standard forms SF-424 and SF-LLL are required

sources.quote: All applicants must submit the following standard forms: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance SF-LLL Disclosure of Lobbying Activities

items.title: Capital projects must submit a Benefit-Cost Analysis narrative and an unlocked calculation spreadsheet

sources.quote: Benefit-Cost Analysis Narrative (capital projects only) BCA Narrative
There should be two BCA files included in the application: (1) a narrative description of the BCA; and (2) an unlocked spreadsheet revealing the underlying calculations

items.title: Project location file (Shapefile or KML/KMZ)

sources.quote: Applicants should submit one of the following file types that detail the project's location so the Department can verify location designations

items.title: Budget table must show total cost by component and the three funding sources

sources.quote: At a minimum, the budget table must show the total project cost by project component and the following funding sources

items.title: Cost estimates no older than a year from the deadline, with an inflation factor

sources.quote: Cost estimates should be no older than a year from the application deadline and include an inflation factor.

items.title: State the NEPA class of action

sources.quote: NEPA Class of Action: List the class of action/type of document that has already been or will be prepared to comply with the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) of 1969

items.title: Say whether the project is already listed in the STIP, TIP, TTIP and/or TAM Plan

sources.quote: Is the project already listed in the STIP, TIP, Tribal Transportation Improvement Program (TTIP), and/or Transit Asset Management (TAM) Plan, if applicable?

items.title: Applications must be submitted through the portal by the stated deadline

sources.quote: Applications must be submitted through Valid Eval by 5:00 PM eastern on February 24, 2026.
